name: pdk-tasking-manager-fenced-task-locks
instr:
# Proposal: fenced mapping and validation sessions

## Background
The team needs mapping and validation sessions to remain safe across API workers and the scheduler. Task status and history live in PostgreSQL/PostGIS.

## Proposal
Add fenced task leases so an earlier session cannot change a later holder's work.

## Requirements
- The existing POST routes `lock-for-mapping/{task_id}/` and `lock-for-validation/` under `/api/v2/projects/{project_id}/tasks/actions/` return `leaseId` on each locked task. Only one session can acquire a task across workers; competing locks respond 409.
- Mapping submit (`unlock-after-mapping/{task_id}/`), stop (`stop-mapping/{task_id}/`), validation submit (`unlock-after-validation/`), stop (`stop-validation/`), extension (`extend/`) and split (`split/{task_id}/`) require the current token. Missing, expired or stale tokens respond 409 without changing the task or newer owner. Send `leaseId` per entry of `validatedTasks` and `resetTasks`, and at the top level for other requests.
- Successful mapping (`status: "MAPPED"`) and validation (`status: "VALIDATED"`) submissions leave the task in that status, unlocked. Every lease has one opening history action (`LOCKED_FOR_MAPPING` or `LOCKED_FOR_VALIDATION`) and one matching closing action (`UNLOCKED_FOR_MAPPING` or `UNLOCKED_FOR_VALIDATION` on release; `AUTO_UNLOCKED_FOR_MAPPING` or `AUTO_UNLOCKED_FOR_VALIDATION` on expiry). Both history entries carry the same nonnegative elapsed duration in `action_text`
